_doc: ElevenLabs text-to-sound spec for GATE 0 (tools/sfx_elevenlabs/gen.py). Per sound: prompt, dur (s, 0.5-30), loop (seamless loop, v2 model), inf (prompt influence 0-1), ch (1 = mono for 3D emitters, 2 = stereo), trim (cut leading silence), slice (footsteps: cut N single steps of `step` s from one take; names <name>_1..N). Levels are matched to the procedural file each sound replaces, so the mix in code stays valid; new names use `level` (RMS dBFS).
style: Realistic, clean, high quality foley recorded in a vast, empty, modern airport terminal at night; liminal, quiet and slightly eerie. No music, no voices unless asked.
